clauses.title: The invocation map offers the manifest builders and the required-evidence check
requires: so a request carrying both mode fields is unrepresentable
it requires every `file`-kind required-evidence entry to exist before the expectation is built

clauses.title: A required file that does not exist is an assembly error, never a gate outcome
requires: every `file`-kind entry of that set must exist, verified through packaged `required_evidence_check` before the expectation is built
a required file that does not exist is an assembly error and never a gate outcome (CL-D61)

clauses.title: Builder and check fixtures pin the surface, the unrepresentable request, the round trip, and the record
requires: the invocation map names the manifest builders and the evidence check
the CLI exposes the two builders and the check with frozen inputs
a request carrying both mode fields cannot be produced by a builder
the built requests round-trip through manifest_compare at AFTER_STAGING and BEFORE_COMMIT
every built capture request passes the consumer's authorized-path rules, differentially
required_evidence_check makes a nonexistent required file an assembly error
CL-D61 records the builders, the check, and the CL-D56 widening
